about: Announcements shown on the Home page of the Tohyee server app (Windows), next to the GitHub releases. Edit this file on main and GitHub Pages publishes it to https://willy-nz.github.io/Tohyee/news.json. Each item: date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, body, and optionally link (https) and kind ("conference" shows it in the conference card).

items.title: Tohyee 0.15.0: invite people, and a security update
items.body: New: invite people from People and roles, with a setup link emailed to new people. Next.js is updated to fix critical security problems, so update soon. The demo farm is now added from the server's Organisations page.

items.title: Tohyee 0.14.0: try the demo farm
items.body: New: add Kōwhai Dairies Ltd, a made-up dairy farm with farm records, books, payroll, GST and Analytics reports, from the organisation menu. Also security fixes: removing someone's Google sign-in now disconnects their AI apps, keys and PowerPoint add-in sign-ins, and restoring people from a backup keeps their Google sign-in. Update soon if you use those.

items.title: Tohyee 0.13.0
items.body: New: Claude.ai, ChatGPT and other AI apps connect by signing in to Tohyee instead of copying a key, with a much shorter AI page; and a PowerPoint add-in that puts live, clickable Analytics reports on slides. Both need Remote access.

items.title: Tohyee 0.12.0
items.body: New: Analytics much closer to Power BI, with themes, many more charts and maps, report pages, click-to-filter, drill-down, bookmarks, calculations, year to date and relationships between tables; staff kept to their own farms; checked backups with a recovery kit and restore wizard; IRD account file imports (not yet reviewed by an accountant); filing email attachments; and Sign in with Google for invited people. Before updating, read the release notes: farm staff need farms assigned.

items.title: Tohyee 0.11.0
items.body: New: a farm dashboard as Home; My mail, a private copy of an owner's own email for them and their AI; a co-op share register; SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL and Google Analytics in Analytics; chart formatting, key figure comparisons and flexible layouts; one look for every graph; CRM tidy-ups; and provisional tax payment allocation (not yet reviewed by an accountant).

items.title: Tohyee 0.10.0
items.body: New: income tax from the books (provisional tax, interest, tax depreciation, the imputation credit account and the IR10, IR4 and IR3 boxes, not yet reviewed by an accountant); pasture and feed records; a Farming API for your own apps; a farm calendar from your own email; livestock reporting choices; expected sick leave; and clearer screens.

items.title: Tohyee 0.9.0
items.body: New: Tier 3 and Tier 4 not-for-profit performance reports; price changes across repeating invoices; bring in a year's general ledger from MYOB as history; free and negative lines on invoices and bills; copy last week's roster; and security hardening. Read the notes before updating if you have your own scripts.

items.title: Tohyee 0.8.0
items.body: New: farming (paddocks, aerial imagery, fertiliser plans, soil tests, benchmarks); livestock for tax; jobs, rosters and clocking in; a bigger CRM; year-end financial statements and an accountant pack; your AI on the farm. Before you update, read the notes on two-step sign-in and remote access.

items.title: On main: jobs, rosters and clocking in
items.body: Development update: jobs with visits, checklists, photos and materials on the invoice; rosters costed against a weekly budget; staff clocking in with a PIN on a shared device, straight onto their timesheets; and livestock now covers deer and goats. These are in 0.8.0.

items.title: On main: expanded CRM and new livestock tools
items.body: Development update: leads, sales teams, follow-ups, campaigns, team forecasts and deal quotes; livestock movements, supported herd scheme and NSC valuations, agent account sales and monthly management values. These are in 0.8.0. Farm budgeting and industry benchmarking remain planned.

items.title: Tohyee 0.7.0
items.body: New: bank feeds from SimpleFIN, Stripe, PayPal and Wise; statement files from a folder or mailbox; bank rules with conditions and splits; a bills inbox, approval rules and Pay now links; cash flow forecast and consolidation; WooCommerce orders; Excel sources and pivots in Analytics; Ctrl+K search. Plus fixes from the October project review.

items.title: Save the date: TohyeeCon
items.body: The first Tohyee conference is coming to Ōtepoti Dunedin… one day. Date to be confirmed (probably after payroll is built). 🐶
